## Fewer releases, without losing the ability to test a change

Until now every merge published its own pre-release. That is why this project
cut 13 releases in one day and 64 in a week, on a page that customers read, and
why the version number climbed from 2.96 to 3.29 in four days while telling you
nothing about what had changed.

This release is the first half of fixing that. Nothing about how your system
updates changes yet — this build teaches it a new way to spot an update, so that
the next release can stop creating one per fix.

### What's new

- **Dev systems no longer need a release to update.** A dev system already
  installs straight from the `dev` branch; it only ever needed a release to be
  told that something new existed. It now compares the exact commit it was built
  from against the branch, so it can see new work the moment it lands.
- **The update page shows you what actually changed.** Instead of a version
  number that moved by 0.01 for reasons nobody can reconstruct, a dev system now
  reports how many commits it is behind and lists them, newest first.
- **Release notes can be drafted for you.** A new `npm run notes:draft` collects
  everything that landed in a range so notes are written once per release
  instead of once per fix. The draft is a starting point to edit, not a
  finished changelog.

### Changed

- Routine work no longer needs a version bump or a notes file. The version now
  moves when a build is actually cut, so it can start meaning something again.
- The update check reads a wider window of releases. The old window was small
  enough that a busy week could push every stable release out of view, leaving a
  healthy system reporting that it had nothing to install.

### For administrators

Nothing to do. Stable systems are unaffected and continue to update exactly as
before. Dev systems pick this up on their normal schedule.

If a dev system has been powered off for a long time and shows no updates after
this changeover, run this once on the console to bring it back in step:

```
bash /opt/training-tracker/deploy/update.sh
```
